CODE
 import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

debt_data = {
    'Year': [2005, 2005, 2005, 2005,
             2006, 2006, 2006, 2006,
             2007, 2007, 2007, 2007,
             2008, 2008, 2008, 2008,
             2009, 2009, 2009, 2009],
    'Quarter': ['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'] * 5,
    'Instrument Volume (B USD)': [
        7800, 8200, 8500, 8300,
        8100, 7900, 7600, 7400,
        7200, 6900, 6500, 6200,
        5800, 5200, 4500, 3800,
        3200, 2900, 2600, 2400
    ],
    'Average Yield (%)': [
        3.5, 3.6, 3.8, 4.1,
        4.3, 4.2, 4.0, 3.9,
        4.1, 4.4, 4.7, 5.0,
        5.3, 5.6, 6.0, 6.4,
        5.9, 5.7, 5.2, 4.8
    ],
    'Default Rate (%)': [
        0.8, 0.7, 0.6, 0.5,
        0.4, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9,
        1.0, 1.2, 1.5, 1.8,
        2.2, 2.8, 3.5, 4.2,
        3.8, 3.6, 3.3, 3.0
    ],
    'Region': [
        'North America', 'Europe', 'Asia-Pacific', 'Emerging Markets',
        'North America', 'Europe', 'Asia-Pacific', 'Emerging Markets',
        'North America', 'Europe', 'Asia-Pacific', 'Emerging Markets',
        'North America', 'Europe', 'Asia-Pacific', 'Emerging Markets',
        'North America', 'Europe', 'Asia-Pacific', 'Emerging Markets'
    ]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(debt_data)

pivot_table = df.pivot_table(
    values='Default Rate (%)',
    index='Year',
    columns='Region',
    aggfunc=np.mean
)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.imshow(pivot_table, cmap='YlGnBu', aspect='auto', interpolation='nearest')

plt.colorbar(label='Default Rate (%)')
plt.xticks(range(len(pivot_table.columns)), pivot_table.columns, rotation=45)
plt.yticks(range(len(pivot_table.index)), pivot_table.index)
plt.xlabel('Region')
plt.ylabel('Year')
plt.title('Debt Instrument Default Rates by Region and Year (2005-2009)')

for (i, j), val in np.ndenumerate(pivot_table):
    plt.text(j, i, f'{val:.1f}', ha='center', va='center', color='black')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')

from pathlib import Path
p = Path("chart.py")
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace("aggfunc=np.mean", "aggfunc='mean'")
s = s.replace("plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))", "pivot_table = pivot_table.reindex(columns=['North America', 'Europe', 'Asia-Pacific', 'Emerging Markets'])\n\nplt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))")
s = s.replace("cmap='YlGnBu'", "cmap='YlOrRd'")
p.write_text(s)
exec(compile(s, "chart.py", "exec"))
ax = plt.gcf().axes[0]
expected = pd.read_csv("table.csv").set_index("Year")
np.testing.assert_allclose(ax.images[0].get_array(), expected.to_numpy())
print("Region order:", [t.get_text() for t in ax.get_xticklabels()])
print("Year order:", [t.get_text() for t in ax.get_yticklabels()])
print("Palette:", ax.images[0].get_cmap().name)
print("Color limits:", ax.images[0].get_clim())
print("Title:", ax.get_title())
print("Colorbar ticks:", plt.gcf().axes[1].get_yticks())
